newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index slightly up in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index slightly up in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed slightly up by 0.19 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 502.94 points from 502.00 on Monday.
Total volume was 6.75 million dinars against 2.67 million. Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 4.25 million dinars from 2.2 million dinars over the previous session.
Turnover on the first market was 2.28 million dinars with 77,463 shares changing hands.
Detergents firm Societe des Produits Chimiques Detergents won 1.04 dinars to 36.14 dinars. Banque de Developpement Economique de Tunisie gained 1.01 dinar to 17.44.
Chemical firm Al-Kimia was up 0.7 dinar to 50 dinars. Banque de l'Habitat rose 0.6 dinar to 20.6.

Banque Nationale Agricole fell 0.94 dinar to 30.56 dinars with 31,459 shares traded. Banque du Sud slid 0.81 dinar to 26.9 dinars. Banque de Tunisie et des Emirats d'Investissement was down 0.28 dinar to 23.
Societe Frigorifique et Brasserie de Tunis declined 0.52 dinar to 92.5 dinars.
